referral_withdrawal_chain_check.name: referral_withdrawal_chain_check
referral_withdrawal_chain_check.value:
("referral_withdrawal_intents"."method" = 'BINANCE_UID' AND "referral_withdrawal_intents"."blockchain" IS NULL) OR
        ("referral_withdrawal_intents"."method" = 'BLOCKCHAIN' AND "referral_withdrawal_intents"."blockchain" IN ('BSC', 'ARBITRUM'))

account_activity_entity_check.name: account_activity_entity_check
account_activity_entity_check.value:
("account_activity"."entity_type" IS NULL AND "account_activity"."entity_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("account_activity"."entity_type" IS NOT NULL AND "account_activity"."entity_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "account_activity"."entity_type" IN ('user', 'session', 'account', 'payment_intent', 'payment_evidence', 'subscription_grant')
      AND char_length("account_activity"."entity_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 160)
